goal: Expose a `Task` dataclass (with grader and `Context` types) from the `flywheel` package whose `validate()` enforces every rule defined in `docs/task-schema.md`.

constraints: Direct dataclass construction must remain a first-class API; no loader/parser may become the sole construction path.
The dataclass and its nested types must not couple to any input format (JSON, file paths, streams) — the type is a pure data shape.
`validate()` is a method on the struct, not gated on a serialized form.
non_goals: Single-file, directory, and JSONL loaders (handled by `roadmap-01-task-loaders`).
edge_cases: `graders` must contain at least one entry.
`prerequisites` must not contain the task's own id.
A `transcript` grader requires at least one of `max_turns`, `max_total_tokens`, or `max_wall_seconds`.
`id` defaults to a uuid4-derived value when absent and must contain no whitespace.
Unknown grader `type` values are rejected by `validate()`.
A `rubric` grader must have a non-empty `assertions` list; a `manual` grader must have an `instruction`; a `command` grader must have a `run`.
context.notes: Memory note `feedback_task_schema_input_agnostic.md` is the governing constraint on input-source agnosticism.

assertions: The Task dataclass module does not import `json`, `pathlib`, `io`, or any file/stream API, and no constructor argument accepts a file path or raw serialized payload.
Tests demonstrate constructing a Task directly via the dataclass (no loader helper) and calling `validate()` on it.

`validate()` rejects each violation enumerated in `docs/task-schema.md`: missing `goal`, empty `graders`, self-referential `prerequisites`, whitespace in `id`, a `transcript` grader with no limit set, and an unknown grader `type`.
graders.name: schema-fidelity
